newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Jackson weds former nurse in secret Sydney ceremony.
newsitem.headline: Jackson weds former nurse in secret Sydney ceremony.

text.p: American pop superstar Michael Jackson and his pregnant girlfriend surprised the world on Friday with an early-morning wedding after a concert in Sydney.

Details of the marriage, confirmed by a spokeswoman for Jackson and his Australian promoter, were shrouded in secrecy while Jackson and his bride slept off the wedding party in their luxury hotel suite.
"They're still asleep up there," said a spokeswoman for tour promoter Paul Dainty outside Jackson's Sydney hotel.
"Paul was hosting what was supposed to be a small post-show party, but it turned into a wedding breakfast," she added.

In Los Angeles, Jackson spokeswoman Christine Holevas said the superstar exchanged wedding vows with Debbie Rowe, a 37-year-old nurse, after kicking off the Australian leg of his HIStory world tour with a sell-out concert in Sydney.
"They are married. All I know is that it happened," Holevas said.

"Please respect our privacy and let us enjoy this wonderful and exciting time," Jackson, recently divorced from the daughter of the late Elvis Presley, said in a written statement distributed on the Internet global computer network.
The wedding took place only 10 days after Jackson announced that Rowe, who nursed the star while he was being treated for a rare skin disorder, was due to give birth to his child early next year.
Jackson denied news reports that Rowe had been artificially inseminated and that he paid US$500,000 to carry his child.
"I am thrilled that I will soon be a father and am looking forward with great anticipation to having this child," Jackson said when the pregnancy was announced.
This is second time that Jackson -- known for a bizarre fantasy lifestyle surrounded by children and with a pet chimpanzee -- has been married in secret.

In January, Lisa Marie Presley, daughter of late rock and roll legend Elvis, filed for divorce, citing irreconcilable differences 20 months after they were married in secret in the Dominican Republic.

Shortly before that marriage, Jackson was embroiled in a legal battle after allegations that he sexually molested a young boy. Jackson vehemently denied the claims and prosecutors said in late 1994 that they were not pressing criminal charges.
Jackson agreed earlier that year to pay the boy a multi-million dollar settlement in return for droppng a civil lawsuit against him.

Rowe has reportedly been divorced for eight years from her first husband and lives in an apartment in the Los Angeles suburb of Van Nuys. She is said to have met Jackson 15 years ago while working for a doctor who was treating the entertainer for the skin condition vitiligo.
Rumours swirled around Sydney on Friday about the details of the wedding.
Various radio and television stations reported that Jackson had married Rowe at a seedy inner-city chapel for the homeless known as The Wayside Chapel.
But a spokesman for the Chapel told Reuters this was not true, pointing out that under Australian law, at least a month's notice is necessary before a marriage can be performed.
A solitary fan stood outside Jackson's hotel on Friday morning. "It's pretty shocking," said 16-year-old Helen Lindsay, gazing up at the hotel's upper floors and clutching an autograph book and pen.
"I don't think he should have done it, not after what happened with Lisa Marie," Lindsay said.
